rows.contextNote: The 0.96 N weight of the metre stick acts downwards and must be included.

corrected.notesBefore: Carded because the scheme awards three discrete, checkable stated values rather than undifferentiated working. The data table is reproduced verbatim in the scheme, so the question is answerable without a figure.

fieldsBefore.stem: A student investigated the laws of equilibrium for a set of co-planar forces acting on a metre stick, calculating the net force and the sums of the clockwise and anticlockwise moments about an axis.

fieldsBefore.stem: In an experiment to verify the principle of conservation of momentum, two trolleys were held in contact with a light compressed spring between them. When the spring was released, both trolleys moved with a constant velocity in opposite directions.

rows.contextNote: Awarded on either route - the scheme prints this line without a double solidus.

corrected.notesBefore: The scheme prints // on the first two lines, so route a is the card-and-timer method and route b is the ticker-tape method; each route reaches the full 9 marks (its two routed points plus the shared v = l/t line). Partial answers from the two sides may not be combined.

fieldsBefore.stem: Two trolleys, A and B, were held in contact and at rest with a light compressed spring between them. When the spring was released, both trolleys moved with a constant velocity in opposite directions. Trolley A travelled a distance sA in a time tA, while trolley B travelled a distance sB in a time tB. Data: mass of A = 200 g; mass of B = 250 g; sA = 10 cm; tA = 185 ms; sB = 8 cm; tB = 190 ms.

corrected.notesBefore: Scheme prints a single combined [2 + 1] for the two stated velocities, so the split is order-dependent and both rows carry null marks. Units are part of the answer - the preamble deducts one mark for omitted or incorrect units in final answers.

fieldsBefore.stem: Two trolleys, A and B, were held in contact and at rest with a light compressed spring between them.

rows.contextNote: The scheme separates these two with a solidus, so either momentum value earns the 3 marks.

fieldsBefore.questionText: Calculate (i) the charge stored on one of the plates, (ii) the energy stored by the capacitor.

The extractor stacked the fraction in the first formula as 'C = q' over 'V'; it is written here as C = q/V (the solidus is a division sign, not an alternatives solidus). Exponents in the scheme text lost their superscript formatting in extraction.

fieldsBefore.stem: A spectral line in a distant galaxy is observed in a laboratory on Earth to have a frequency of 7.14 × 10¹⁴ Hz. The same line produced and observed in the laboratory has a frequency of 7.59 × 10¹⁴ Hz.

corrected.notesBefore: Carded because the scheme awards a named formula and a final answer with its unit as two discrete points. The extractor stacked the fraction (printing 'fc' above 'f' = c ± u'), so the formula is written here in linear form. The exponent of the final answer lost its superscript formatting in extraction ('1.89 x 107'); it is restored here to the value the scheme prints, 1.89 × 10⁷ m s–1. The row read "u = 1.89 × 10⁷ m s–1"; the scheme prints the answer alone, and with the letter x as its multiplication sign. Labelled with an em dash so the row still says which quantity it is while the claim is the scheme's own text.
